name: Supporting Relations with the Kali Tribe

steps.name: Supporting Relations with the Kali Tribe (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Melvic] in "Underground City Tartaros", then find [Noel].

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Thank you for your interest in supporting relations with the Kali tribe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. Tell me about it. If I can help, I'd like to...

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Certainly. Do you know the Kali tribe?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, not at all.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: The Kali are one of Eastland's many minority peoples.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: They currently live in the village of Kali, somewhere in the Land of Illusions.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Somewhere...? You don't know exactly where it is?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Correct. Apparently, only someone powerful or exceptional can find it. Someone like Shynic might locate it easily.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait... Does that mean someone as strong as Shynic lives there? It sounds like they've set up something to keep people out...

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Exactly. You catch on quickly. The Kali tribe's leader, Medea, is a Champion.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd like to meet her soon.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Shynic has entrusted all relations with the other Champions to me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Because she finds it boring and bothersome, obviously?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Hehe. Perhaps. Perhaps not.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: If the Dark Holy Kingdom of Deimos seriously targets our city, Jude and even Lumen will be in danger.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: That's why we want to maintain the closest possible ties with the Champions.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: We cooperate to some extent with Lumen, where Ziskad lives. But apart from our common enemy, Weiss, relations with the others are rather distant.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Lord Atkina lives in Dragon Valley in the Land of Illusions, but ordinary humans can't enter.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: And the Blizzard Empress is too far away... while the Fierce King can't be reasoned with...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So you're approaching the nearest Champion with the best chance of cooperation.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: That seems wisest. One reason for optimism is that Shynic apparently had dealings with the Kali tribe in the past.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: It's been a long time since then... Noel suggests bringing goods from outside as a first step toward renewing relations.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Noel is Kali herself, and more eager than anyone to renew those ties. Please go hear what she has to say.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: I'm counting on you. This may even serve the god you follow, adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll talk to Noel. And please put in a good word for me with Shynic.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: You needn't worry about that. Hehe.

steps.name: Supporting Relations with the Kali Tribe (2)
steps.objective: Obtain an <Awakener for Dreamers>, a <Magic Sea Droplet>, and a <Darkness-Infused Pearl>, then report to [Layer] in "Underground City Tartaros".

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: What a wonderful adventurer! Won't you buy something?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...I am rather wonderful, but isn't that smile a little too obviously for sales?

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: I have to make a living. If you're not buying, come back later. Not so wonderful after all...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Isn't that a bit harsh? Anyway, Melvic told me to come see you...

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: What? Melvic? The handsome Melvic? What did he say about me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your attitude changed fast when I mentioned him.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Oh! Did it? I'm sorry. Go on. If he sent you, I'll do a-anything!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You tell Noel about your conversation with Melvic.)

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Oh! Really? You'll get those goods? No one's ever volunteered to fetch them before...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. It's important work.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: So you want something from our Kali tribe, too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nothing underhanded. There's something I need to do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You explain what brought you to Tartaros and why you are helping establish relations with the Kali tribe.)

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: I understand. At least I know you aren't using my people for something bad. Then I'll tell you what we need.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Thank you. I fought with the villagers and ran away, so I'm ashamed... But I still want to help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll help, too. I promise. So could you put away the merchandise you're waving in front of me?

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Tsk. Didn't work.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll buy plenty another time. For now, I'll fetch those supplies.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Oh, right. Once you have them, bring them to Layer. He'll keep them safely in the warehouse. And...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And...?

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Please put in a good word with Melvic. Tell him Noel took great care explaining everything.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll tell him. Don't worry.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Thank you for thinking of my people. Please be careful.

steps.name: Supporting Relations with the Kali Tribe (3)
steps.objective: Find the princess of a certain kingdom.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Noel told me. You've brought goods to establish ties with the Kali tribe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Here they are.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: I'll keep them safely in storage and hand them to Melvic when the time comes.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: It reminds me of meeting Medea of the Kali tribe long ago.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm curious about her. I think I'll need to meet her someday...

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: I don't know how useful it will be, but would you like to hear the story?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: In my youth, I was a mercenary who took any job that paid. I'm embarrassed to say I even had the cheesy title 'Beast of the Desert.'

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: I was returning alone to Jude after a job when I became faint and collapsed. It must have been the Land of Illusions near Tartaros.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: I knew nothing about the place. Lying there, I thought I would die...

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Fortunately, I woke in a mysterious village of people with animal ears. That was Kali.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: With their leader Medea's help, I recovered quickly and soon returned to Jude.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: It was extraordinary. I'd experienced plenty of healing magic, but never anything as pure, clear, and powerful as hers...

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: I wondered if she was a goddess incarnate.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Maybe she's that powerful because she's a Champion?

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Perhaps...? That was thirty years ago now.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Since you're working to build relations, could you bring one more thing?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: A book. Medea loves books, but in such a remote village, some are impossible to find. She was disappointed about one in particular.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: If you added the book she wanted to the supplies you've brought, it might help...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What book?

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: One containing someone's memories, she said. I don't know the details, but a princess on a distant continent paid to have it made and distributed free...

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Do you know it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hmm. That book...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I remember.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: It makes me happy to imagine Medea finally reading it. If you find it, bring it to me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not certain yet, so I'll check with the person who has it first. Bringing it back comes after... I'll return with good news soon. Just wait!

steps.name: Supporting Relations with the Kali Tribe (4)
steps.objective: Obtain <Scenario Book Vol. 1> from [Herne] at the "Elias Royal Palace", then report to [Layer] in "Underground City Tartaros".

lines.speaker: 헤르네
lines.text: Wow, adventurer! Herne missed you so much!

lines.speaker: 헤르네
lines.text: What adventures have you had? Tell me!

lines.speaker: 헤르네
lines.text: I heard you went to the Eastern Continent and the continent in the sky!

lines.speaker: 헤르네
lines.text: Tell me! Tell me!

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: Herne, slow down. You'll run out of breath.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right, Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: 헤르네
lines.text: Hehe, sorry. What brings you to see Herne?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You explain that you need a book to help establish relations between a village and a city on another continent.)

lines.speaker: 헤르네
lines.text: A book a princess on a distant continent paid to publish and give away... Hmm...

lines.speaker: 헤르네
lines.text: Oh, I know!

lines.speaker: 헤르네
lines.text: It's this book Herne has!

lines.speaker: 헤르네
lines.text: The book about big sister Iris. We still have plenty. Please take one to her.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Princess.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What story would you enjoy? How about the Champions of the Eastern Continent?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You briefly tell Herne about your recent adventures.)

lines.speaker: 헤르네
lines.text: Wow... You're amazing, adventurer!

lines.speaker: 헤르네
lines.text: When I grow up, I want to have adventures like yours!

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: (Hejong keeps clearing his throat, apparently displeased, and stares at %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ahem. Perhaps I shouldn't have told her that...)

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: A word with you, please.

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: Herne's growing interest in the outside world worries me. Your stories aren't bad, but I can't help feeling anxious.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, I understand, Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 헤르네
lines.text: Adventurer, can't you tell me more? Tell me about big sister Iris, too!

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: Now, Herne. The adventurer is busy. If not today, we can hear more another time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry, Princess. I have work to do... Until next time, Your Majesty. Farewell, Princess.

lines.speaker: 헤르네
lines.text: Aww... I suppose it can't be helped. But come see Herne again! Promise!

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: You're back, so you must have found the book.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. It was easier than I expected.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: May I take a look?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: A remarkable book... Full of wistful memories... But I've heard the name Iris somewhere...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She's the girl who defeated the Demon King and succeeded Goddess Seres as this world's god.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Ah... The goddess's name?

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Truthfully, I never cared who the god was. I've lived trusting only myself.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Everyone has a troubled story, but I feel Goddess Iris's must be sadder than most.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: I wonder why Medea wanted this book.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You could ask when you meet her again.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Again... It's lonely, not knowing when that might be.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Enough of that idle talk. You kept me from being bored. I've enjoyed this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If I go to Kali, I'll give Medea your regards.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Thank you. You're a special person. I'm sure you'll reach Kali and meet her.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: If you ever need my help, come anytime. For you, I'll always lend a hand. Good luck.
